category_tagline_len.name: category_tagline_len
category_tagline_len.value: "category"."tagline" is null or char_length("category"."tagline") between 1 and 120

hero_image_alt_len.name: hero_image_alt_len
hero_image_alt_len.value: "hero_image"."alt_text" is null or char_length("hero_image"."alt_text") between 1 and 200

offer_popup_alt_len.name: offer_popup_alt_len
offer_popup_alt_len.value: "offer_popup"."alt_text" is null or char_length("offer_popup"."alt_text") between 1 and 200

product_name_bn_len.name: product_name_bn_len
product_name_bn_len.value: "product"."name_bn" is null or char_length("product"."name_bn") between 1 and 200

product_rating_halves_valid.name: product_rating_halves_valid
product_rating_halves_valid.value: "product"."rating_halves" is null or ("product"."rating_halves" between 2 and 10 and "product"."rating_halves" % 2 = 0)

inventory_movement_adjustment_needs_acto.name: inventory_movement_adjustment_needs_actor_and_note
inventory_movement_adjustment_needs_acto.value: "inventory_movement"."reason" <> 'stock_adjustment' or ("inventory_movement"."actor_staff_id" is not null and "inventory_movement"."note" is not null)

cancellation_request_has_origin.name: cancellation_request_has_origin
cancellation_request_has_origin.value: "cancellation_request"."requested_by_customer_id" is not null or "cancellation_request"."recorded_by_staff_id" is not null

cancellation_request_decided_consistent.name: cancellation_request_decided_consistent
cancellation_request_decided_consistent.value: "cancellation_request"."state" in ('open', 'withdrawn') or ("cancellation_request"."decided_at" is not null and "cancellation_request"."decided_by_staff_id" is not null)

customer_return_inspection_has_actor.name: customer_return_inspection_has_actor
customer_return_inspection_has_actor.value: "customer_return"."state" not in ('inspected_accepted', 'inspected_rejected', 'closed') or ("customer_return"."inspected_at" is not null and "customer_return"."inspected_by_staff_id" is not null)

order_cancelled_has_reason.name: order_cancelled_has_reason
order_cancelled_has_reason.value: "order"."cancelled_at" is null or "order"."cancelled_reason" is not null

order_additional_cost_void_complete.name: order_additional_cost_void_complete
order_additional_cost_void_complete.value:
("order_additional_cost"."voided_at" is null and "order_additional_cost"."voided_by_staff_id" is null and "order_additional_cost"."void_reason" is null)
          or ("order_additional_cost"."voided_at" is not null and "order_additional_cost"."voided_by_staff_id" is not null and "order_additional_cost"."void_reason" is not null and char_length(btrim("order_additional_cost"."void_reason")) >= 3)

order_event_system_actor_has_no_actor.name: order_event_system_actor_has_no_actor
order_event_system_actor_has_no_actor.value: "order_event"."actor_type" not in ('system', 'guest') or ("order_event"."actor_customer_id" is null and "order_event"."actor_staff_id" is null)

payment_claim_verified_needs_actor_and_a.name: payment_claim_verified_needs_actor_and_amount
payment_claim_verified_needs_actor_and_a.value: "payment_claim"."state" <> 'verified' or ("payment_claim"."resolved_at" is not null and "payment_claim"."resolved_by_staff_id" is not null and "payment_claim"."verified_amount_minor" is not null)

payment_claim_adverse_decision_needs_act.name: payment_claim_adverse_decision_needs_actor_and_reason
payment_claim_adverse_decision_needs_act.value: "payment_claim"."state" not in ('rejected', 'falsely_claimed') or ("payment_claim"."resolved_at" is not null and "payment_claim"."resolved_by_staff_id" is not null and "payment_claim"."resolution_reason" is not null and char_length("payment_claim"."resolution_reason") >= 10)

payment_claim_has_origin.name: payment_claim_has_origin
payment_claim_has_origin.value: "payment_claim"."submitted_by_customer_id" is not null or "payment_claim"."recorded_by_staff_id" is not null

refund_has_origin.name: refund_has_origin
refund_has_origin.value: "refund"."requested_by_customer_id" is not null or "refund"."recorded_by_staff_id" is not null

refund_completed_requires_evidence.name: refund_completed_requires_evidence
refund_completed_requires_evidence.value: "refund"."state" <> 'completed' or ("refund"."completed_at" is not null and "refund"."completed_by_staff_id" is not null and "refund"."evidence_note" is not null and char_length("refund"."evidence_note") >= 5)

refund_failed_requires_reason.name: refund_failed_requires_reason
refund_failed_requires_reason.value: "refund"."state" <> 'failed' or ("refund"."failed_at" is not null and "refund"."failure_reason" is not null)

customer_flag_cleared_consistent.name: customer_flag_cleared_consistent
customer_flag_cleared_consistent.value: "customer_flag"."state" <> 'cleared' or ("customer_flag"."cleared_by_staff_id" is not null and "customer_flag"."cleared_at" is not null and "customer_flag"."clear_reason" is not null)

operational_exception_closed_needs_actor.name: operational_exception_closed_needs_actor_and_note
operational_exception_closed_needs_actor.value: "operational_exception"."state" not in ('resolved', 'dismissed') or ("operational_exception"."resolved_at" is not null and "operational_exception"."note" is not null)

delivery_setting_conditional_amounts_ran.name: delivery_setting_conditional_amounts_range
delivery_setting_conditional_amounts_ran.value:
("delivery_setting"."conditional_min_subtotal_minor" is null or ("delivery_setting"."conditional_min_subtotal_minor" >= 0 and "delivery_setting"."conditional_min_subtotal_minor" <= 100000000))
        and ("delivery_setting"."conditional_dhaka_minor" is null or ("delivery_setting"."conditional_dhaka_minor" >= 0 and "delivery_setting"."conditional_dhaka_minor" <= 100000000))
        and ("delivery_setting"."conditional_chattogram_minor" is null or ("delivery_setting"."conditional_chattogram_minor" >= 0 and "delivery_setting"."conditional_chattogram_minor" <= 100000000))
        and ("delivery_setting"."conditional_others_minor" is null or ("delivery_setting"."conditional_others_minor" >= 0 and "delivery_setting"."conditional_others_minor" <= 100000000))

delivery_setting_repeat_amounts_range.name: delivery_setting_repeat_amounts_range
delivery_setting_repeat_amounts_range.value:
("delivery_setting"."repeat_chattogram_minor" is null or ("delivery_setting"."repeat_chattogram_minor" >= 0 and "delivery_setting"."repeat_chattogram_minor" <= 100000000))
        and ("delivery_setting"."repeat_others_minor" is null or ("delivery_setting"."repeat_others_minor" >= 0 and "delivery_setting"."repeat_others_minor" <= 100000000))

delivery_setting_repeat_discount_range.name: delivery_setting_repeat_discount_range
delivery_setting_repeat_discount_range.value:
("delivery_setting"."repeat_discount_percent" is null or ("delivery_setting"."repeat_discount_percent" >= 1 and "delivery_setting"."repeat_discount_percent" <= 100))
        and ("delivery_setting"."repeat_discount_min_subtotal_minor" is null or ("delivery_setting"."repeat_discount_min_subtotal_minor" >= 0 and "delivery_setting"."repeat_discount_min_subtotal_minor" <= 100000000))

promo_code_shape_matches_kind.name: promo_code_shape_matches_kind
promo_code_shape_matches_kind.value:
("promo_code"."kind" = 'percent') = ("promo_code"."percent_off" is not null)
        and ("promo_code"."kind" = 'fixed') = ("promo_code"."amount_off_minor" is not null)

promo_code_max_discount_applies_to_perce.name: promo_code_max_discount_applies_to_percent
promo_code_max_discount_applies_to_perce.value:
("promo_code"."max_discount_minor" is null or ("promo_code"."kind" = 'percent' and "promo_code"."max_discount_minor" > 0))
        and ("promo_code"."max_discount_minor" is null or "promo_code"."max_discount_minor" <= 100000000)

promo_code_window_ordered.name: promo_code_window_ordered
promo_code_window_ordered.value: "promo_code"."starts_at" is null or "promo_code"."ends_at" is null or "promo_code"."ends_at" > "promo_code"."starts_at"

product_review_decision_complete.name: product_review_decision_complete
product_review_decision_complete.value:
("product_review"."state" = 'pending' and "product_review"."decided_by" is null and "product_review"."decided_at" is null)
          or ("product_review"."state" in ('approved', 'rejected') and "product_review"."decided_by" is not null and "product_review"."decided_at" is not null)
